classification_rationale: The customer is asking about return logistics for the concrete breaker at the end of the rental, which is a standard collection/return question.

draft.reply_body:
Hi Ville,

Thanks for the message. Yes, you can simply drop the concrete breaker back at the Oulu depot during our normal opening hours - there's no need to book a specific time, just bring it to the returns desk.

One thing worth mentioning: once we've checked the equipment in, your damage deposit is returned in full within five working days, as long as everything comes back undamaged and complete.

If you're not sure of our current opening hours, let us know and we'll send them over.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
